tier_should.rationale: Strong, novel causal evidence of intergenerational child mortality reductions from randomized deworming using 23-year KLPS. Identification credible; policy relevance high. Some concerns: mortality rarity, recall/attrition, external validity. Best fit: top field in development/health.

tier_will.rationale: Elite authorship, NBER WP, and KLPS platform plus policy salience make placement strong. Despite deworming controversy and statistical challenges, results appear credible. Likely top field or marginal A-journal; outside chance at general-interest.
